name: ToolRet
description: ToolRet is a heterogeneous tool retrieval benchmark designed to evaluate information retrieval models on their ability to select useful tools from large toolsets for tool-using large language models. It contains 7.6k diverse retrieval tasks and a corpus of 43k tools, reflecting realistic scenarios beyond simplified pre-annotated tool sets.
reputation: A newer but well-regarded retrieval benchmark in the tool-use community, often cited for its realistic large-toolset setting.
notes: Includes a large-scale training dataset with over 200k instances; reveals poor performance of conventional IR models on tool retrieval tasks.
